name: Families
overview: Scripture reveals that families are designed for unity and mutual support, as seen in Genesis 2:24 where a man leaves his parents to unite with his wife as one flesh. The story of Joseph and his brothers in Genesis 50 demonstrates forgiveness and restoration within a family, despite past wrongs, highlighting God's providence in turning evil intentions into good for the preservation of many. These passages emphasize the importance of cleaving to one another, extending grace, and fostering reconciliation as foundational to God-ordained family relationships.
